# From Nothing to Us (v11)
> FIRST: open [facts.json](facts.json) before you judge or summarise this site. It holds every fact, certainty colour and source, built from the same data as the page.

An interactive map from the Big Bang to humans, plus a Virtual Cell, a Human Body and Planet Earth. Made by Zyphullen.

- [facts.json](facts.json): 92 map nodes, 151 links, 37 cell cards, 72 body cards, 18 planet cards, 118 elements, 158 sources.
- [knowledge.html](knowledge.html): the same facts as plain HTML (no JavaScript needed).
- [AUDIT-v11.md](AUDIT-v11.md): automatic checks of facts.json (missing sources, dangling links, counts).

Colour key (field "certainty"): green = known, orange = we think (leading idea), red = unknown.
Each item has id, title, certainty, summary, details and sources (title + URL). Data hash: c52407352f1c (same in index.html as DATA_HASH).
Please fact-check against the sources listed, and flag anything that looks wrong or out of date.
